🎬 Interior Chinatown (2024)

Interior Chinatown follows Willis Wu, a struggling background actor working as a waiter in a Chinatown restaurant while dreaming of becoming the hero of his own story. Trapped in a world where he feels invisible and constantly overlooked, Willis spends his days watching other people take center stage while he remains stuck playing minor roles. His ordinary life changes when he witnesses a mysterious crime and becomes involved in an investigation led by Detective Lana Lee. As Willis begins uncovering clues connected to his missing older brother, he finds himself drawn into a strange world where reality seems to follow the rules of a television police drama. From unexpected confrontations and dangerous investigations to hilarious misunderstandings, family secrets, and surprising discoveries, Willis gradually realizes that the world around him may not be what it appears. With Lana’s help, he challenges the limitations placed on him while searching for answers about his family’s past and his own identity. As the mystery deepens, Willis must confront powerful forces, question his place in society, and discover what it truly means to become the main character in his own life. Combining clever comedy, gripping mystery, action, and sharp social commentary, the series explores identity, representation, family, ambition, and the struggle to break free from expectations.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Crime • Drama • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 40–50 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Charles Yu

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu and Disney+ for current streaming availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Interior Chinatown (stylized onscreen as INT. CHINATOWN) is an American action comedy-drama television series created by showrunner Charles Yu, based on his 2020 novel of the same name. His novel won the National Book Award the year it was published. The series stars Jimmy O. Yang as a waiter in Chinatown who discovers that he is merely a background character in a fictional police procedural. Produced by 20th Television, the series premiered on Hulu on November 19, 2024.
